title: I love a fun weird theatre thing!!!! #moulinrouge #moulinrougebroadwa...
transcript: I was at Moulin Rouge tonight and the set broke and it was actually the coolest I don't know about you but as a live theatre person I just love when like weird things that can only happen in live theatre happen during firework Ashley went out and the curtain came down behind her and I was like that's weird that's not what normally happens there and then the end of the firework a stage manager came out of stage and kind of like ushered her out and then an announcement came up and they were like we're having a tech delay pause we sit there for 20 minutes and JT and I are talking and we're like wonder what's going on cause this was like a long one and for like a hot second I was worried they were gonna cancel cause it had gone on for so long but then they were like okay we're restarting and then the curtain opened and the Elephant Room set was all the way at the back of the stage against the backdrop like this is the backdrop this the Elephant Room set is there and the entire stage is in front of them like I can't even express to you how far back the Elephant Room was they do ‘your song’ they do ‘so exciting’ from the back of the stage oh and they don't have access to the balcony cause again The Elephant Room is like all the way against the wall so they had to resage a little bit of so exciting but that was fun curtain then comes down again we get ‘sympathy for the Duke’ we do get the french set for Nature Boy this funny cause can you hear it moulin rouge anyway they then raise the curtain and we get elephant love medley but again with the entire stage in front so they can't like flip the elephant room around so they have to restage it but they do such a good job honestly it was so exciting it felt like a wicked no fly show like I've never been to a wicked no fly show but I now have been to a Moulin Rouge no Elphaba roomshow Ashley Loren and Christian Douglas like crushed it rolled with the punches everyone did so good the ensemble the cast the crew I love live Theatre kids night on Broadway so Wayne Brady made a little speech and it was very cute we gave you 20 minutes extra show yeah no one else on Broadway will give you 20 minutes to talk amongst yourself you're welcome this is the kind of stuff that only happens at theaters so we are so lucky
